evidence: Workbook 'Quality Checks' row 42 (check 41) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 42 note (binary+weights; likert said unused) read; skill SKILL.md:65 and references/quality-checks.md:168-170 direct judging against the shipped format: flag binary craft criteria or likert blocks lacking anchors, not likert itself. Parsed all five frozen judge.toml files with tomllib. gates/render (hro_gate_render) and gates/constraints (hro_gate_shared): 1 criterion each, type=binary, both observable pass/fail outcomes (staged-task-contract.md:96 requires binary gates). scored/functional: 152 criteria, all binary, all behavioural outcomes; the only quality-flavoured words ('readable' in hro_audit_text/revision/rescission/readback, hro_change_preview, hro_change_audit; 'clearly' in hro_keep_revision_terms) qualify presence of human-readable actor/target/before-after content, not a degree of craft. scored/polish: 5 criteria, all binary (hro_pol_live_keeps_entries, hro_pol_session_resume, hro_pol_focus, hro_pol_change_recovery, hro_pol_uncertain_commit); each states measurable observables (field value, document.activeElement, scrollY, sign-in prompt, retry shows the original result) with explicit 'Fails if' conditions, matching the template where polish is also all binary. scored/visual: 5 criteria (hro_vis_type, hro_vis_color, hro_vis_layout, hro_vis_hierarchy, hro_vis_consistency; judge.toml:17-90), all type=likert, points=5, and each description carries five described anchors 5/4/3/2/1 (25 anchor lines counted). Scale check: the template visual criteria add a '0:' anchor and an 'Explicit 0-5 scale' prompt section; the task instead uses 1-5 and visual/prompt.md:7,12,16 says lowest is 'Likert 1', 'minimum raw Likert score1, which normalizes to zero', 'five anchors'. Verified against the pinned harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (tests/Dockerfile:31; wheel downloaded for reading only, sha256 recorded in sources_read): models.py:47 normalizes max(0,min(1,(raw-1)/(points-1))) and models.py:50 renders 'an integer from 1 to 5'. So every level the judge can validly return (1..5) has a described anchor, 1 maps to 0.0, and the task wording agrees with the engine hint; the omitted 0 anchor is not a missing level. Broken-app probe: an unstyled but working app lands on anchors 1-3 per criterion rather than a forced 0/1, so gradation is retained; a blank shell is told to take raw 1 = 0. Conforming-alternative probe: visual prompt disclaims screenshot match, framework, phone layout and theme switching, so a differently styled conforming app is not pushed off the anchors. No binary craft criterion and no anchorless likert found. Limits: this is a source/static review plus reading of the pinned scorer source; no configured judge run exists in raw-evidence-index.json (sha256 ece7f65b63eddea22b144c678f836792b9d7635940e9e57033baf555eebabb60, which states full configured grading is absent), so how the configured judge actually applies the anchors is not exercised. The row itself is decidable from source.
